lines.en: I walk slowly, leaning on my cane.
Step by step, I cross the village.
My back is a little bent.

lines.zh: 我走过门口，往里看一眼
lines.en: I pass a doorway and glance inside.
I know these stone paths well.
I pause by the vegetable plot.
The soles of my shoes are worn thin.
I carry something homeward.
I go around the younger ones at play.
I walk by the wall, out of the wind.
My cane taps the ground.
I'm slow, but I don't miss my duties.

lines.zh: 我从集市那头走到这头
lines.en: I go from one end of the market to the other.
I stop and nod to someone.

lines.zh: 这条村路我走了几十年。
lines.en: I have walked this village road for decades.
I lean on the wall and rest.
I sit on the step by the door.
I lean my cane against my knee.
The sun makes me drowsy.
I watch the people passing.

lines.zh: 这村子比我年轻时大了
lines.en: This village has grown since my youth.
My fingers tap on my knee.
I take a slow sip of water.
Wind lifts the cloth under the eaves.
I look up; rain is coming.
I roll my shoulder.
Someone calls a child home.

lines.zh: 我记得这些屋子的旧样
lines.en: I remember how these houses used to look.

lines.zh: 我把拐杖在地上顿了顿
lines.en: I tap my cane on the ground.
I walk slower; don't hurry me.
The shade is cooler than indoors.
I straighten my back, slowly.
You're from outside, aren't you?
I look up at you; my eyes are still sharp.
Your boots are covered in dust.

lines.zh: 像你这样的旅人我见多了。
lines.en: I have seen many travelers like you.
Are you buying, or asking the way?
I speak slowly. Be patient.
Sit down. Talking standing is tiring.
I don't like being deceived.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西给我看看
lines.en: Let me see what's in your hand.
Strangers rarely come here.

lines.zh: 你不用扶我，我还走得动
lines.en: Don't help me. I can still walk.
Young one, mind your tone.
I lean on the wall and catch my breath.
That blow bends me over.
My cane falls to the ground.
I straighten up, slowly.
Blood runs from my brow.
At my age, I can't take much.
I retreat behind the door frame.
Someone steadies me.
Do not help me; I can stand with my cane.
Stop. I'm old.
I'm not short of that.
What would you want for this?
I look at the price and shake my head.
Too dear. Not worth it.
I've better at home.
Only the young care for such things.

lines.zh: 长者拄着拐，只换稀罕物。
lines.en: The elder leans on his cane, trading only rarities.

lines.zh: 我拿不动那么重的东西
lines.en: I can't carry anything that heavy.
I might take it in trade for something else.
I'm old. I don't covet such things.
First, tell me where it came from.
I've no use for this.
Put it away. I'm not buying.
If you truly want to trade, ask less.
I've seen better than this.
The goods are fine. The seller isn't.
Sorry. I don't move quickly.
I plant my cane and don't fall.
Just steady me a moment.
This alley is too narrow.
I turn aside to let the young pass.
I bumped you. No harm done.
My cane caught your foot.
Thank you. I can stand on my own.
Watch where you're going.
These old bones are still sound.
My wife passed years ago.
I set such things down long ago.
If you're lonely, come sit often.
At my age, I only want peace.

lines.zh: 有人在身边，说话有回音
lines.en: It's good to have someone to answer you.

lines.zh: 我的拐杖，比年轻人的剑稳。
lines.en: My cane is steadier than a young one's sword.
Sit with me a while.
Bustle belongs to the young.
I remember those who've gone.
You'll grow old too.
I bend to pick it up, slowly.
My knees are bad; I need the wall.
I'll take this.
I can't manage two of them.
Dropped is dropped.
I put it in my basket.
Whose is this? I'll wait.
I count them. All there.
Too heavy. I'll need two trips.
Would you kindly pick it up for me?
There are footsteps outside.
I raise my head and look to the door.
That step isn't from the village.
I grip my cane tighter.
The young should go first.
I move a little behind the door.
I know where the bolt is.
A shadow passes the window.
I cough once.
They've stopped.
I look through the crack in the door.
Can't see clearly; too dark.
I raise my cane.
It hardly counts as a weapon.
But I can block with it.
There are three of them.
The village bell hasn't rung.
I step back to the door.
I wait for them to move first.
The children are still outside.
I swing my cane.
It lands on a shoulder.
I'm not as strong as I was.
But I know where to hit.
He backs off two steps.
I raise the cane again.
I shield the people behind me.
My hands shake, but don't let go.
Come again and I'll go for the face.
You shouldn't have come here.
I've lived in this village many years.
I built the step by my door.
The young ones run past.

lines.zh: 我叫住一个问了问天气
lines.en: I stop one and ask about the weather.
The sun is good today.
My cane is newly whittled.
I walk slowly to the market.
Someone greets me.
I nod and walk on.
At noon I'll go back and sleep.
My sleeve caught fire; I beat at it.
I fell and can't get up.
Water chokes my throat.
The blast throws me against the wall.
An arrow sticks in my leg.
This light leaves me cold all over.
There's no food at home. I can't hold on.

lines.zh: 雷把我耳朵震得听不见
lines.en: Thunder leaves my ears deaf.

lines.zh: 我脚下空了，一直往下坠
lines.en: The ground vanishes and I keep falling.
